# Life Order (Self-Control OS)

System focus: Discipline, Behavioral Science, and Habit Architecture.

## Core Features
- Diagnostic Onboarding (60s)
- Nadir AI Mentor (Personalized contextual feedback)
- Habit Protocol (3 daily missions, XP, Streak, Shield)
- Circadian Scheduling
- Burnout Detection

## Technical Stack
- Framework: TanStack Start v1
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Auth: Supabase Auth (OAuth 2.1, Google)
- Styles: Tailwind CSS v4 (Obsidian Premium theme)
- Icons: Lucide React
- Deployment: Lovable Cloud (Edge Functions)

## Access
- URL: https://life-orderuz.lovable.app
- API: /api/public/*
- Investors: /investors (Confidential)
